description: gap-closing:gap-backlog-unhealthy-1781835273472 has failed 27 times in the last 24h under a single failure class (cascading), and NO OPEN GAP NAMES IT. The count is not the defect — the defect is that the system observed the same fact 27 times and changed nothing: it did not stop selecting the activity, did not open a gap against the cause, and did not try a different route. The class is recorded, so the typed-delta path applies; the open question is why the repetition itself never became a disposition. First action is to classify the failure, not to suppress the count: identical failures should not be possible, and where they occur they remain independent samples.
